units: <cite ref="Ketubot 23a:16">Keth. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>בנן דמ׳ אינון</he> they are the daughters of a scholar.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:9">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ</cite> top <he>מ׳ דנשיא</he> (not <he>דנש׳</he>) the teacher of the Nasi (R. Judah); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2:9">Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ</cite>; ib. VIII, beg. 51ᵃ <he>מוֹרְיָינֵיה דנשייא</he>.
